## Activity

During August 2026, Market Eye Clinic completed 39 captures. This represents the activity recorded for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below. The reported activity was reviewed as part of the routine site operations report.

## Image quality

Of the 39 captures completed during August 2026, 7 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 17.9 per cent. These results indicate that a proportion of images could not be used for assessment and should remain a focus of routine quality monitoring. The site should continue to review image-acquisition practice and address any recurring issues identified through local checks.

## Grading

Grading identified 10 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the typical interval from image capture to completion of grading remained short during the reporting month. The results should be considered alongside the image-quality findings when reviewing site performance.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. Overall, the report records the site’s activity, image quality, and grading position for August 2026.
